name: The World Government
description: The union of more than a hundred and seventy kingdoms that has ruled the seas for eight hundred years, from the Holy Land of Mary Geoise.
goal: Preserve order, and the order that keeps the World Nobles on top.

name: The Marines
description: The Government's navy: bases in every sea, ranks from seaman recruit to fleet admiral, and a creed of Justice painted on every coat.
goal: Hunt pirates and keep the seas in order.

name: The pirates of the world
description: Not one faction but thousands of crews under thousands of flags, from rowboat raiders to emperors of the sea. Their strength is the sum of every crew sailing.
goal: Fame, treasure and freedom, in whatever order.

name: The Revolutionary Army
description: A secret army that frees kingdoms from their rulers and means, one day, to free the world from the World Government.

name: The kingdoms of the world
description: Every crowned head of the four seas and the Grand Line, members of the World Government or proudly outside it. They count for something together and very little apart.
goal: Survive: their thrones, their tribute, their pirates.

name: The underworld syndicates
description: Smugglers, fences, slave traders and the brokers who sell Devil Fruits to the highest bidder. They run the black markets of every port that has one.
goal: Profit, from anything that can be bought or sold.

name: The merchant guilds
description: Traders, shipwrights and the news companies whose gulls carry the papers to every deck at sea.
goal: Trade, safely and at a profit.

name: The Goa Kingdom
description: The kingdom of Dawn Island, whose nobles dream of being invited to Mary Geoise and would burn their own slums to look tidy for the visit.
goal: Be noticed by the World Nobles.

name: The Drum Kingdom
description: A winter kingdom whose doctors were once the best in the world, until a king decided medicine was for the royal family alone.

name: The Alabasta Kingdom
description: One of the twenty founding kingdoms of the World Government, ruled by the Nefertari line, who alone among the founders stayed home.
goal: Rain, and peace for its people.

name: The Dressrosa Kingdom
description: A kingdom of the New World ruled by the gentle Riku family, which keeps no army to speak of and no secrets it knows of.

name: Wano Country
description: The samurai country, ruled from the Flower Capital by its shogun and its five daimyo, outside the World Government and proud of it.

name: The Ryugu Kingdom
description: The undersea kingdom of Fish-Man Island, whose kings have long wanted to live under the sun beside the humans who fear them.
goal: Move to the surface, in peace.

name: The Mokomo Dukedom
description: The Minks' realm on the back of Zou, ruled by two lords: one of the day, one of the night.
goal: Keep their promise and their secret.

name: The Kingdom of Amazon Lily
description: The island of women warriors in the Calm Belt, ruled by the captain of its pirate crew.

name: The Kingdom of Elbaf
description: The country of the giants, the strongest warriors in the world, who will fight anyone and lie to no one.
goal: Honour, in battle and out of it.
